resources.string: Keep 50% for 2 practice days to recover one step. Reach 60% to become healthy. Earned levels and rewards stay yours.

Each completed scheduled loop earns 1 point, once per loop each day. Completing 2 different loops adds 1 bonus point; the daily total is capped at 3. A new loop qualifies after 3 days and 2 scheduled occurrences. There is no weekly cap or required loop count. Upgrade with enough points, a healthy tree, and a 14-day completion average of at least 60%.

The tree keeps its earned level. Its leaves wilt after the average of the last 7 settled practice days stays below 60% for 7 practice days, below 40% for 14, or below 25% for 21. Rest days and unfinished today are excluded. Initial records and uncertain schedules do not cause wilting. Points keep accumulating while wilted.

Reward days accumulate when the 14-day loop-balanced average meets the threshold. Rest days pause counting; earned rewards stay yours. Green leaves rise when healthy; dry leaves fall when wilted. Special effects are hidden while wilted and return after recovery.
Each loop has equal weight in the completion average. Historical misses remain in their original schedule even when a loop is disabled later.
